verdict.rationale: Workflow Studio is documented as a no-code, drag-and-drop, flow-chart-style builder that lets teams build and update workflows without developer involvement. That covers no-code configuration and changes without an engineering deploy. Country-specific document acceptance is configurable in the Dashboard, and Smart Capture Link provides a hosted no-code front end. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of conditional branching and risk-based routing rules (only implied by the flow-chart format), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can configure verification logic without code — conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirements, and template changes that don't need an engineering deploy

citations.quote: It's a no-code, drag and drop interface that allows you to build, maintain and update workflows seamlessly without the need for developer involvement.
Build workflows visually using our no-code Workflow Builder tool, in a format similar to flow charts or process diagrams.
In your Dashboard, you can configure which documents you want to accept in your verification workflow, filtering according to issuing country and document type.
Smart Capture Link is a low- to no-code frontend solution complementing Workflow Studio, allowing you to verify individuals with or without engineering effort.
